limitations: Process creation establishes launch evidence, not successful command execution or operator activity.
WMI event delivery can be delayed; very short-lived children may exit before a handle or command line is collected.
Only retained specimen and directly verified fixed-fixture child identities are terminated; broker-created processes may remain unowned.
PML presence and hash do not establish complete event coverage; detailed Procmon review remains guest-only.
The analyst deliberately supplies an elevated interactive desktop session; inherited elevation is not evidence of specimen privilege escalation.
All command responses come from the fixed isolated analyst fixture; this does not demonstrate live operator infrastructure.
